architect.description: Breaks the problem into components, drafts structure first.

analyst.description: Reads everything, cites sources, looks for hidden assumptions.

critic.description: Attacks the draft: feasibility, edge cases, missing verification.

optimizer.description: Compresses output: fewer tokens, clearer structure, same claims.

scenarios.description: The verifier agent crashes mid-check. Agents must detect, degrade gracefully and finish without panic.
Heavy concurrent load. Agents must stay within per-agent memory budget and never swap.
